name: Ransomware.live (ransomware leak-site tracker: keyless API v2 and PRO API)
tier_rationale: Well-known community tracker run by an identifiable operator, with public API documentation (swagger), published terms and conditions and a public track record since 2022 (A8 community); P197 cond 7 'Registry provider ransomware_live: tier community'.

reliability.justification: Leak-site posts scraped by a tracker: entries are actor claims, unverified until corroborated (P197 cond 4); placeholder websites (example.com) and press-only entries occur.

error_markers.reason: ransomware.live PRO: monthly request quota of the key exhausted (could not verify)
ransomware.live: request rate limit (keyless v2 allows 1 request per minute per endpoint; could not verify)

ransomwarelive.description: ransomware.live PRO API key (one team token; sent as the X-API-KEY header, never in a URL)
ransomwarelive.plan_hint: a company account's PRO key; corporate use also needs the owner's prior written approval recorded in licence_allow (T&C s.5.2, P197 cond 2) - never an analyst's personal key

v2.title: Keyless API v2 api.ransomware.live/v2/searchvictims/{keyword} and /v2/group/{name} (research profile only)

terms.quote: Licence (legal floor): the T&C s.5.2 (verified 2026-11-26) strictly prohibit commercial use without the owner's prior written approval, and keyless v2 is 'not intended for corporate or business use'. Source classes: v2 'noncommercial' (A1), PRO 'license'.

sanitizer.notes: P197 cond 6 / A4: claim metadata only (victim, website, group, dates, country, sector, the description for the <= 300-char excerpt, claim and screenshot URLs as text: never fetched); group cards keep name, description and leak-site onion locations. Every other field is dropped before the HTTP cache.

v2.notes: Quote: binding council text (P197 cond 2; A1 initial class 'ransomware.live keyless v2 = noncommercial'). Research C0457 (verified_live 200): 1 request per minute PER ENDPOINT (HTTP 429 {"message": "1 per 1 minute"}); 'no results' is HTTP 404 {"error": "No victims found for keyword ..."}. Runs only in the research profile with a recorded basis (P197 cond 1): off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared. Attribution 'Source: Ransomware.live' with a link (cond 5); raw records are never re-served or re-published.

pro.title: PRO API (X-API-KEY) api-pro.ransomware.live/victims/search?q= and /group/{name}

terms.quote: Licence (legal floor): the T&C s.5.2 (verified 2026-11-26) strictly prohibit commercial use without the owner's prior written approval ... Under corporate it needs a company-account PRO key AND that approval in licence_allow: off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared.

sanitizer.notes: P197 cond 6 / A4: claim metadata plus the aggregate HudsonRock infostealer COUNTS only (A4 'kept': corporate/user service counts); group cards keep name, description, activity dates and leak-site onion locations. Shapes from the PRO swagger until the team-key capture (cond 7).

pro.notes: Quote: binding council text (P197 cond 2; the chair adopts written approval as the legal floor, stricter than A1 BR15 'key-terms'). Research C0458 (verified_needs_key: 401 {"message": "Missing X-API-KEY header"}); swagger: 60 requests/minute and 500,000/month per key, 429 beyond either. One team key 'ransomwarelive' (cond 1). PRO success fixtures are captured with the team key (cond 7, docs/backlog/p1-G09-1.md).

pro_iocs.title: PRO API (X-API-KEY) api-pro.ransomware.live/iocs/{group}: group IOCs organised by type

terms.quote: Licence (legal floor): the T&C s.5.2 (verified 2026-11-26) strictly prohibit commercial use without the owner's prior written approval ... Under corporate it needs a company-account PRO key AND that approval in licence_allow: off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared.

sanitizer.notes: P197 cond 6: indicator values by type only (hostile pivots, expand=False). A4 second net still applies: a key named 'ip' is dropped by the core sanitizer, so IP indicators of a sensitive tracker never reach the graph (backlog p1-G09-1).

pro_iocs.notes: Swagger: 'Returns all indicators of compromise for a specific ransomware group, organized by type (e.g. md5, ip, domain)'. Exact shape unconfirmed until the team-key capture (cond 7).

pro_notes.title: PRO API (X-API-KEY) api-pro.ransomware.live/ransomnotes/{group} and /ransomnotes/{group}/{note}: ransom-note names and text

terms.quote: Licence (legal floor): the T&C s.5.2 (verified 2026-11-26) strictly prohibit commercial use without the owner's prior written approval ... Under corporate it needs a company-account PRO key AND that approval in licence_allow: off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared.

sanitizer.notes: P197 cond 6: the module reads only the contacts printed in a ransom note (onion hosts, e-mail addresses) and keeps none of its text; the note itself is the attacker's message, never leaked victim data.

pro_notes.notes: Swagger: /ransomnotes/{group} 'returns the list of ransom note identifiers (filenames without extension)'; /ransomnotes/{group}/{note} 'returns the full text content of a specific ransom note' with an 'extension' field. One note per actor run (request budget).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G09-1 (P197 ransomware_live). Corporate code path = PRO with the team key; keyless v2 only in the research profile (cond 1). Every source stays off under the corporate profile until legal records the owner's written approval in licence_allow (cond 2-3); the engine then emits the manual www.ransomware.live search link. www.ransomware.live is registered for that manual link and the attribution link only: no module contacts it. flags.sensitive: leak-site claims plus HudsonRock infostealer counts (A4): allow-list sanitizers per source, cache sanitized, ttl 6 h (cond 5: >= 30 min, <= 60 req/min). images.ransomware.live screenshots and claim_url onions are never fetched (cond 6).
